summary: Cases on whether y ∈ 𝖴K(g): if y = k·(element of K(g)), then xy = (x k x⁻¹)(x ...) gives the representative x k u ... with σ additive; otherwise neither xy is in 𝖴K(g).

steps.claim: Case analysis on the definition of phase(g, y).
steps.lean:
fun_cases phase g y <;> rename_i H
  · rw [phase_eq (mul_mem ((besselS_le_normalizer_besselU hx _).1 H.choose_spec.1) hu) (by
      simpa using mul_mem f H.choose_spec.2), ← P.ψ.map_add_eq_mul]
    grind -ac [simpleRootSum_mul, mul_mem, inv_mem, inv_mul_cancel_left,
      mem_unitriGroup_of_mem_besselU]
  rw [phase, mul_zero, dite_eq_right fun ⟨v, hv, q⟩ ↦ H ⟨_,
    (besselS_le_normalizer_besselU (inv_mem hx)
    _).1 (mul_mem hv (inv_mem hu)), by simpa using mul_mem (inv_mem f) q⟩]

steps.claim: y ∈ k·K(g) with k ∈ 𝖴: then xy ∈ (x k x⁻¹)u·K(g) with x k x⁻¹ ∈ 𝖴 (𝖲 normalises 𝖴), so phase(g, xy) = ψ(g⁻¹σ(xkx⁻¹u)) = ψ(g⁻¹σ(u))ψ(g⁻¹σ(k)).
steps.lean:
· rw [phase_eq (mul_mem ((besselS_le_normalizer_besselU hx _).1 H.choose_spec.1) hu) (by
      simpa using mul_mem f H.choose_spec.2), ← P.ψ.map_add_eq_mul]
    grind -ac [simpleRootSum_mul, mul_mem, inv_mem, inv_mul_cancel_left,
      mem_unitriGroup_of_mem_besselU]

steps.claim: y ∉ 𝖴K(g): then xy ∉ 𝖴K(g) either (otherwise y = x⁻¹(xy) would be), so both sides are 0.
steps.lean:
rw [phase, mul_zero, dite_eq_right fun ⟨v, hv, q⟩ ↦ H ⟨_,
    (besselS_le_normalizer_besselU (inv_mem hx)
    _).1 (mul_mem hv (inv_mem hu)), by simpa using mul_mem (inv_mem f) q⟩]
